changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.9

- Further performance pass to lower CPU and memory use while Destiny 2 is focused.
- Foreground-window detection is cached, removing repeated process lookups on every overlay frame and hotkey tick.
- The overlay reuses a single back buffer instead of allocating a full-screen bitmap on every repaint.
- Overlay fonts and vector icon geometry are cached instead of being rebuilt each frame.
- No changes to gameplay, keybinds, swaps, the clear tracker, or the update process.
